name: Sudarat Srisawat
bio:
Sudarat's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying fine arts in Bangkok, she took a part-time job at a custom auto body shop. It was there she discovered a passion for the meticulous artistry involved in achieving a flawless paint finish. She quickly excelled, mastering techniques from classic airbrushing to modern ceramic coatings.

Her dedication to precision and eye for detail caught the attention of a Eurofarma RC scout during a local car show. Sudarat's approach to her work is deeply rooted in understanding the science behind paint application. She meticulously analyzes environmental conditions and material properties to ensure optimal results. Her innovative problem-solving skills, particularly in color matching and surface preparation, have made her an invaluable asset to the team. Sudarat strives for perfection and is known for her unwavering commitment to delivering exceptional results under pressure, making her a distinctive member of the Eurofarma RC team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair with subtle highlights, usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Sudarat is petite and athletic, with a focused expression and a determined glint in her dark eyes.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when not actively spraying.
Carries a small, well-worn sketchbook filled with color palettes and design ideas.
Insists on cleaning her workspace with a specific brand of organic cleaner.
